description:
We are AI Squad, an interdisciplinary team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our goal is to identify Earth locations that resemble potential permanent Moon base and Mars settlement locations using AI, data analysis, scientific research, and visualization.

Our team brings experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Python, software development, and data-driven problem-solving. We aim to build an innovative solution that analyzes environmental conditions
summary:
Earth2Mars AI is an AI-powered planetary analog discovery platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It aims to help researchers identify and compare Earth environments that share selected geological and environmental characteristics with the Moon and Mars.

The platform brings together geospatial analysis, environmental feature comparison, interactive maps, and similarity-based discovery to explore potential terrestrial analog locations. Users can investigate environments such as deserts, polar regions, and other extreme landscapes to understand their relevance to planetary exploration.

By making planetary analog discovery more accessible and visual, Earth2Mars AI supports research, technology testing, and preparation for future human exploration missions to the Moon and Mars. It also highlights the importance of using Earth-based environments to study selected conditions of other planetary worlds.
details:
Project Overview

Earth2Mars AI is an intelligent planetary analog discovery platform designed to help explore Earth locations that resemble selected environmental and geological conditions found on the Moon and Mars.

How It Works

The platform organizes planetary analog discovery into several exploration and comparison workflows. Users can explore candidate Earth environments, investigate lunar and Martian analog locations, visualize geographical information, and compare relevant environmental characteristics.

The proposed analytical approach considers factors such as terrain, geology, temperature, minerals, and water-related characteristics. Similarity analysis can help rank candidate locations according to selected features, while interactive visualizations make the results easier to understand.

Main Features

  • Live Maps for geographical exploration.
  • Moon Analogs for investigating lunar-like terrestrial environments.
  • Mars Analogs for exploring Mars-like environments on Earth.
  • Advanced Discovery for evaluating potential analog locations.
  • AI-assisted analysis and comparison.
  • Expedition Planner for organizing exploration activities.

Technologies Used

  • Python for application development.
  • Pandas and NumPy for data processing.
  • Scikit-learn for machine learning and similarity analysis.
  • GeoPandas and Rasterio for geospatial processing.
  • Plotly and Folium for visualization and interactive maps.
  • Streamlit for the interactive web application.

Benefits and Potential Impact

Earth2Mars AI aims to make planetary analog research more accessible, help researchers explore candidate environments, and support preparation for future lunar and Martian missions. It provides a foundation for combining geospatial information and AI-assisted analysis in planetary exploration research.

Creativity and Innovation

The project's creative approach is to connect Earth-based environmental exploration with planetary science through an interactive AI-assisted discovery platform. Rather than examining locations independently, it aims to support systematic comparison of selected characteristics across different worlds.

Scientific Limitations

Earth analog environments can reproduce selected geological and environmental characteristics, but no location on Earth can fully reproduce the Moon's vacuum and reduced gravity or Mars's atmosphere and radiation conditions. Earth2Mars AI is intended as a research-support tool, not a replacement for planetary mission testing.
